text:
olivia: Heads-up — cert-manager ACME webhook CVE-2026-1234 reported this morning. It's an auth bypass in the webhook admission controller when KMS-backed private keys are used. Feels high-risk for Private customers using KMS. Linking advisory: https://github.com/cert-manager/advisories/1234 :warning:

samir: do we have a reproduction? any CVSS? vendor says CVSS 8.1, requires crafted ACME challenge payload to trick webhook into accepting modified order.

miguel: thanks. Can you paste the affected versions? I think our clusters run cert-manager v1.14.0 on Dedicated and v1.13.x in some Private installs.

olivia: affected < 1.15.0 per advisory. vendor recommends patch to 1.15.2+ or apply mitigation: restrict RBAC to only allow cert-manager webhook to `get,patch` secrets in namespace and disable external account binding for ACME if using KMS.

tara: what's the RBAC delta? we need an explicit list for compliance sign-off and audit logging adjustments.

samir: suggested serviceaccount policy:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get","patch"]
```
Also need to ensure webhook pod identity can't access kms keys directly; KMS access should be via controller only.

ashley: For Private customers, KMS integration is through sidecar with key wrapping. If webhook bypass is possible, someone could request ACME certs for arbitrary domains. We should contact compliance and add extra audit retention for last 90 days.

miguel: action items: (1) emergency test upgrade to cert-manager v1.15.2 in staging, (2) run exploit PoC in controlled env, (3) publish mitigation steps for Dedicated and Private, (4) schedule canary deploy to 2 clusters tomorrow morning.

infra-ci-bot: test pipeline triggered: `infra/cert-manager-upgrade-staging` run #427

olivia: Samir/Tara can you prepare RBAC patch + audit retention playbook? Put PR to infra repo.

samir: will open PR, will include `kubectl` patch snippet and helm values:
```
helm upgrade cert-manager jetstack/cert-manager --version 1.15.2 \
  --namespace cert-manager --set webhook.replicas=3
```

tara: Also need log-forwarding change for Private: set `auditPolicy` to `RequestMeta`+write to secure bucket with kms encryption.

ashley: Notifying CSMs now, add mention that Private customers with KMS key policies should rotate keys if they think exposure possible.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-401 cert-manager ACME webhook CVE triage. Pager duty: security-oncall

miguel: timeline proposal: upgrade staging tonight, limited Dedicated canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC, full ramp 24h if no issues. Comments?

olivia: +1. include rollback plan: pin to previous chart and restore webhook replicas.

samir: will add smoke tests: cert issuance, ACME challenge create/delete, and KMS-encrypted secret fetch.

ashley: I'll draft customer notice and legal compliance blurb.

olivia: Great — assigning owners in the incident doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:
